newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was fairly active. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady.

Inquiry wasgood, demand was fair early, light by late morning. Sales confirmed on 20,800 slaughter steers and 12,700 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 56,900 head confirmed including 8,800 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs 71.00, few 1225- 1250 lbs including brahma cross 70.50.
Heifers - select and choice 2-3 1020-1150 lbs 71.00; load select with end choice 70.00.
week to date: 56900 week ago: 62900 year ago: 95000
